$comment: CLIENT CONFIG — CrystalClear Water Solutions (watersoftenersindianapolis.com).
Charter §5: the only file (besides brand tokens and the content tree) this site edits.
GOLDEN RULE (charter §1): if a value is true for ONE client only, it lives
here — never hardcoded in an Engine file.
NEVER FABRICATE. `geo`, `rating`, hours, and every *Confirmed gate default to
null/false/empty, and the Engine omits the corresponding output entirely
rather than inventing it.
OPEN BLOCKERS before launch (do not fabricate — see publishGate below):
· business.phone — NO number supplied yet. The Engine renders the phone in
the header, footer, 404, lead form, FinalCta, and BOTH legal pages. Until
a real (or tracking) number is set, those render empty. HARD launch blocker.
· business.address.street / .zip — service-area business, no public address
confirmed. Schema omits what is blank; the Privacy Policy address line is
incomplete until these land.
· business.geo / rating / hoursSpec — never fabricated; empty until confirmed.
· compliance.claimGates — every certification stays false until the client
produces proof (dossier §4: WQA/NSF/BBB/chamber all [UNVERIFIED]).
· GHL endpoint + GTM id are Cloudflare secrets / build vars, not here.

business.name: CrystalClear Water Solutions
business.$comment_phone: EMPTY ON PURPOSE — no number confirmed. Set the real E.164 number (+1XXXXXXXXXX) before launch; every rendered form (tel:, sms:, schema, display) derives from this one value.
business.$comment_address: Service-area business: the market city/county/state are real and known (the domain, the GSC property, and the whole content tree target Indianapolis/Marion County). street + zip stay EMPTY until a real address is confirmed — the Engine omits blank schema fields.
business.$comment_hours: EMPTY — no hours confirmed. hoursConfirmed false keeps openingHoursSpecification out of schema, and an empty hoursSpec keeps any hours string off the page.
$comment_identity: Entity-identity fields. Each is OMITTED from schema when blank.
`sameAs` stays EMPTY until the real Google Business Profile and any other
authoritative profile exist — a wrong sameAs points Google at the wrong
business (dossier §2 flags exactly this trap with Citizens Energy Group:
Q5122690 is an unrelated Boston nonprofit, NOT the Indianapolis utility).

$comment_licensed: NOT LICENSED — and deliberately silent about licensing. Indiana Code
25-28.5-1-2 expressly EXCLUDES 'the sale or installation of water softening
equipment' from the statutory definition of plumbing, so no state plumbing
license is what authorizes softener work. The site therefore makes NO
licensing claim of any kind, and licenseNumber stays null.
CONSEQUENCE: do not add a 'licensed' badge later without a real Indiana PLA
license number that verifies on the PLA Search & Verify portal.
compliance.$comment_bannedPhrases: NOTE: the current Engine exports BANNED_PHRASES from src/lib/site.js but NOTHING consumes it (no component, no lint rule). It is declarative intent only today — the real enforcement is that no licensing copy is authored. Promoting this to a real core30-lint check belongs upstream in core30-starter.
compliance.$comment_publishGate: The real open items blocking launch. Documentation today (the Engine exports PUBLISH_GATE but no rule reads it yet).
publishGate: business.phone is empty — header, footer, 404, lead form, FinalCta and both legal pages render an empty phone
business.address.street / .zip unconfirmed — Privacy Policy address line incomplete
legal.legalReviewedBy is null — both legal pages ship as drafts with a banner
legal.a2pBrandRegistered is false — do not enable SMS actions in the CRM yet
site.leadSecretName GHL_WEBHOOK_URL not yet bound — form submissions are discarded
every compliance.claimGates entry is unproven — no certification may be claimed

claimGates.$comment: Per-client claim gates, consumed by content rows via { requires: '<gate>', fallback }. EVERY one defaults false, so the claim structurally cannot render. Dossier §4 lists each as [UNVERIFIED] pending client proof.

$comment: Legal-doc + TCPA/A2P posture. Every value is a per-client fact.
`effectiveDate` is a HARDCODED string, never a computed date.
smsConsentRequired = TRUE (client decision): the SMS opt-in box is REQUIRED
to submit, so every lead carries an explicit SMS consent record. This adds
submit friction in exchange for an unambiguous A2P evidence trail.
CONSEQUENCE: a visitor who will not tick the SMS box cannot submit the form
at all — if lead volume matters more than SMS reach, flip this to false and
make the CRM filter on sms_consent === 'yes' before any SMS action.
legalReviewedBy stays null until counsel signs off — both legal pages show a
draft banner and core30-lint warns (publish gate) until then.
a2pBrandRegistered gates turning SMS actions ON in the CRM.
Launch service area = only the suburbs where BOTH population and water-utility
data are verified (dossier §1b recommendation). Brownsburg, Avon, Plainfield,
Zionsville and Franklin are deliberately EXCLUDED until the client confirms it
actually dispatches there and the utility data is verified.
CARMEL CAVEAT: Carmel Utilities softens city water to ~8 grains at the plant,
so blanket 'very hard water' copy is inaccurate for Carmel customers. Any
Carmel-specific page must say 'moderately hard; softened to ~8 grains at the
plant; a home softener is still needed for 0 grains.'

site.$comment_leadTag: CRM tag applied to every lead from this site's quote form.
site.$comment_timeZone: IANA zone for lead-summary local times. Indianapolis observes US Eastern with its own zone id.

$comment: supportingContent is ON for this site: the topic cluster is the whole point
of the rebuild. The GSC audit found 19 of 28 URLs unknown to Google and a
/blog/ soft-404 — the old content cluster was invisible. The supporting
archetype replaces it with spokes that are in the sitemap, mirror-linked,
and each tied to exactly one money page.
supportingContentStability stays 'experimental' (SC-3/5/7/8 WARN, not ERROR).
Promotion to 'stable' is a separate later decision gated on proven lift —
see docs/supporting-content-archetype.md 'Stabilization checklist'.

brand.$comment_footer: logoMark/footerBlurb/footerLegal/favicon each fall back to a derived default when blank (src/lib/site.js). primaryCta is the mobile bar's main button.
